diagram.name: MARI Field Monitoring - Comprehensive Flowchart & Workflows

mxCell.value:
MARI Field Monitoring Application — Complete System Architecture & User Workflows
Comprehensive Flowchart showing all Features, Decision Points, Data Flows, and Role Lifecycle (Volunteer Mobile, Manager Mobile, Admin Web)
ITC Mission Sunehra Kal & Modern Architect Rural India (MARI NGO Partnership)
Diagram Color & Element Legend
🟢 Volunteer Mobile Features & Actions (Emerald Green)
🔵 Manager Mobile Features & Supervision (ITC Blue)
🟣 Admin Web Features & Governance (Indigo / Purple)
🟡 Decision Branch / Conditional Check (Amber Rhombus)
🔴 Final Attendance & Day Close-out (Rose / Red)
⚪ Data Store / LocalStorage & Sync Engine
📑 Reports & Exportable Output (CSV Engine)
Persistent Demo & Presentation Layer

DemoNavbar (Sticky Top Bar)
• One-click Role Switcher (Volunteer | Manager | Admin)
• Device Frame Mode Toggle (390×844 Phone Bezel vs Fluid)
• Reset Demo Data Button (Cleans localStorage state)
• Active User Pill (Rajesh / Vikram / Ananya)
• Quick link to Screen Showcase Gallery (/showcase)

Landing Demo Portal (/ )
• Executive Introduction to ITC Mission Sunehra Kal
• 3 Interactive Module Cards with Feature Highlights
• Direct Launch Buttons for Stakeholder Roles
• Presentation Mode trigger

Screen Showcase Gallery (/showcase)
• Visual Catalog of all 21 Built Prototype Screens
• Rendered Screen PNG Thumbnails
• Role Filtering Tabs (All / Volunteer / Manager / Admin)
• Feature Badges & Route Path Readouts
• 1-Click "Open Screen" Interactive Prototype Launchers

Automated Screenshots Suite
• Playwright Automation Script (scripts/capture-screenshots.js)
• 23 High-Resolution Retina PNGs in /screenshots/
• Standalone HTML Visual Gallery (screenshots/index.html)
• Multi-Viewport Emulation (390×844 Mobile + 1440×900 Web)
TRACK 1: VOLUNTEER MOBILE APP WORKFLOW (390 × 844 px Field Experience)

Volunteer Launches App
/volunteer/login

Screen 1: Volunteer Login
• MARI & ITC Co-branding Header
• Employee ID (MARI-VOL-101)
• Password Field with Eye Toggle
• Remember-Me Checkbox
• 1-Click Auto-Fill Demo Credentials
• Simulated Form Validation

Is Attendance
Punched-in for
Today (12 Oct)?

Screen 2: Field Punch-in (Geo-fenced)
• Simulated Selfie Camera Capture Preview
• Switch Demo Photo Toggle
• GPS Coordinates: 17.6534° N, 80.8987° E
• Location: ZPHS Sarapaka Cluster, Burgampahad
• High Precision Lock (4.2m Accuracy)
• Territory Geo-fence Matched (99% Match)
• Current Date & Time: Mon, 12 Oct 2026, 09:08 AM

Confirm Attendance Action
• Location & Timestamp Verification
• State: "Active on Duty"
• Synchronize with Manager Live Feed
• Success Badge: Attendance Logged

Screen 3: Volunteer Dashboard (/volunteer/dashboard)
• Profile: Rajesh Kumar (MARI-VOL-101, Senior Field Volunteer)
• Today Attendance Status Card: Punched In at 09:08 AM
• Monthly Target Progress: 79.2% Overall Progress Gauge
• Metric Breakdown: Schools (19/24), Students (960/1200), Kits (380/450)
• Quick Action Buttons: Log Activity | Calendar | Route | Punch-out
• Recent Visits Feed: Today's visits at Sarapaka & Burgampahad
Select User Action from Dashboard or Bottom Nav

Screen 4: Monthly Attendance Calendar
• Month Selector: October 2026 (22 Working Days)
• Green Indicator: Present Days (Oct 1, 3, 5, 6, 8, 9, 10, 12)
• Red Indicator: Absent / Unexcused Days (Oct 7)
• Blue Underline: Sundays (Oct 4, 11, 18, 25)
• Amber Indicator: Gandhi Jayanti National Holiday (Oct 2)
• Interactive Day Click: Opens Selected-Day Detail Drawer
  (Punch-in, Punch-out, Hours, Schools Visited, Headcount)

Screen 5: Activity Selection Menu
• Select from 6 Program Activity Cards:
  1. School Visit (Primary Program)
  2. Hospital / PHC Health Visit
  3. Awareness Programme (Tree / Sanitation)
  4. Community Visit (Gram Panchayat)
  5. Review Meeting (Mandal Education Officer)
  6. Other Activity (Logistics & Kits)
• Click redirects to customized form

Screen 6: School Visit Form & Activity Logger
• School Dropdown from Master Registry (e.g. ZPHS Sarapaka)
• District (Auto-filled / Bhadradri Kothagudem)
• Principal Contacted Toggle: [YES] / [NO]
• Students Reached Headcount (Numeric input, e.g. 48)
• Kits / Quantity Achieved (e.g. 48 Health Hygiene Kits)
• Field Observations & Remarks Textarea
• Next Follow-up Date Picker
• Geo-tagged Photo Attachment Preview
• Client-Side Validation (Required fields check)

Activity Saved & Synchronized
• Appends to todayActivities in localStorage
• Increments Today Deliverable Counter
• Success modal: "Activity Recorded!"
• Option: Log Another Activity vs Back to Dashboard

Screen 7: Route History (/volunteer/route-history)
• Date Selector for previous field days (10 Oct 2026)
• Summary Stats: 5 Stops, 14.8 km Travelled, 7h 30m Duration
• Leaflet Map Preview & GIS SVG Topology Fallback
• Interactive Waypoint Markers (1 to 5)
• Chronological Stop Timeline:
  - 09:20 AM: Punch-in Point (Sarapaka Cluster)
  - 10:15 AM: ZPHS Sarapaka School Visit
  - 12:30 PM: Community Center Burgampahad
  - 02:15 PM: MPPS Burgampahad Awareness Drive
  - 04:50 PM: Punch-out Point (ITC Outreach Hub)
• Notice: Historical GPS breadcrumb records, not live tracking

Screen 8: End-of-Day Decision Point
Volunteer navigates to Punch Out

Continue Field Visits
Add another school or hospital session before finalizing day

Screen 8: Daily Close-out Summary Form
• Aggregated Today Summary Metrics:
  - Schools Visited: 2
  - Students Reached: 82
  - Kits Achieved: 82 Kits Distributed
• Day Summary Remarks Textarea
• Issues or Challenges Faced (e.g. Weather, power delays)
• Next Working Day's Plan (e.g. TTWRS Aswapuram visit)
• Action: Confirm Punch-out & Submit Summary

Final Attendance Status: Punched Out
• Timestamp Recorded (05:45 PM)
• Attendance locked for Oct 12
• Calendar status updated to 'present' with full daily metrics
• Synchronized with Zonal Manager Day Summary Report
• Prevents duplicate punch actions
End of Volunteer Field Day

MARI Prototype Data Persistence & Synchronization Engine (DemoContext & localStorage)

Users Store
(mari_field_demo_state_v1_users)
Volunteers, Managers, Admins with targets, achievements, phone, avatar, district

Attendance Punch Store
(mari_field_demo_state_v1_punch)
isPunchedIn, isPunchedOut, punchInTime, punchOutTime, geo-fence coordinates, photo URL

Field Activities Store
(mari_field_demo_state_v1_activities)
Logged school visits, headcounts, hygiene kits, remarks, follow-up dates, verification status

Attendance Calendar Store
(mari_field_demo_state_v1_calendar)
Monthly array of 31 days with Present, Absent, Sunday indicators, and visit counts

Schools Master Registry
(mari_field_demo_state_v1_schools)
380 geo-tagged schools with 11-digit UDISE codes, categories, principal phone numbers

Taxonomy Master Store
(mari_field_demo_state_v1_master)
States, Districts, School Categories, and Field Activity definitions

Real-Time Local Storage Synchronizer & Demo Reset Engine
• State is updated instantly on any form submission, user addition, or punch status change
• Browser refresh keeps prototype state intact with zero data loss
• resetAllDemoData() method wipes localStorage keys and restores initial sample values
• Safe Frontend Sandbox: Zero backend, zero external database, zero network credentials needed
